about.title: About Legendary Concrete Friendswood
text: We visit your property, evaluate the project, and provide a written quote before any work begins.

In Friendswood, concrete has to stand up to more than just daily use. Our hot, humid summers, heavy Gulf Coast storms, and shifting clay soils are tough on driveways, patios, and foundations. If concrete is not installed correctly here, it cracks, settles, and starts to look worn out long before its time.

Legendary Concrete Friendswood specializes in concrete that is designed for our local conditions. We understand how Friendswood's expansive clay soils behave when the weather swings between dry spells and days of heavy rain. We plan each pour with those soil movements in mind, using proper base preparation, reinforcement, and control joints so your concrete can handle years of use.
